SELECT "user".id, "user".casdoor_id, "user".username, "user".email, "user".is_active, "user".is_superuser, "user".is_bot, "user".cash, "user".debt, "user".auto_repay, "user".debt_last_accrued_at, "user".tos_accepted_at, "user".last_liquidated_at, "user".economic_version, "user".credit_frozen, "user".equipped_title_id FROM "user" WHERE "user".id = $1::INTEGER

SELECT position.outcome_id, position.amount, outcome.market_id, market.status, market.closes_at, market.liquidity_b FROM position JOIN outcome ON outcome.id = position.outcome_id JOIN market ON market.id = outcome.market_id WHERE position.user_id = $1::INTEGER AND position.amount > $2::NUMERIC(16, 6)

SELECT fx_wallet.pair_id, fx_wallet.foreign_amount, fx_pair.status, fx_pair.reduce_only, fx_pair.gold_reserve, fx_pair.foreign_reserve, fx_pair.sell_fee_rate, fx_pair.buy_fee_rate, fx_pair.pool_version FROM fx_wallet JOIN fx_pair ON fx_pair.id = fx_wallet.pair_id WHERE fx_wallet.user_id = $1::INTEGER AND fx_wallet.foreign_amount > $2::NUMERIC(16, 6)

SELECT fx_short_position.pair_id, fx_short_position.principal_foreign, fx_short_position.interest_foreign, fx_short_position.interest_last_accrued_at, fx_pair.status, fx_pair.reduce_only, fx_pair.gold_reserve, fx_pair.foreign_reserve, fx_pair.buy_fee_rate, fx_pair.sell_fee_rate, fx_pair.pool_version FROM fx_short_position JOIN fx_pair ON fx_pair.id = fx_short_position.pair_id WHERE fx_short_position.user_id = $1::INTEGER AND (fx_short_position.principal_foreign > $2::NUMERIC(24, 6) OR fx_short_position.interest_foreign > $3::NUMERIC(24, 6))
SELECT fx_treasury.id, fx_treasury.pair_id, fx_treasury.gold_balance, fx_treasury.foreign_balance, fx_treasury.updated_at FROM fx_treasury WHERE fx_treasury.pair_id = $1::INTEGER FOR UPDATE
